dn34:2.2.64: asubhasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā pahānasaññā virāgasaññā.
dn34:2.2.68: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.69: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.70: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.71: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.72: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.73: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.74: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.75: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn34:2.2.76: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn34:2.2.80: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti
dn34:2.2.81: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti
dn34:2.2.82: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti
dn34:2.2.83: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti
dn34:2.2.88: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
dn34:2.2.90: iti ime navuti dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.

dn34:2.3.7: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. yaṃpāvuso bhikkhu bahussuto hoti …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
dn34:2.3.10: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
dn34:2.3.11: yaṃpāvuso bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko

dn34:2.3.16: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

dn34:2.3.20: yaṃpāvuso bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye oḷārapāmojjo

dn34:2.3.29: yaṃpāvuso bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakataṃpi cirabhāsitaṃpi saritā anussaritā

dn34:2.3.46: viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyaṃ anvayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.

dn34:2.3.54: micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā micchākammanto micchāājīvo micchāvāyāmo micchāsati micchāsamādhi micchāñāṇaṃ micchāvimutti.
dn34:2.3.58: pāṇātipāto adinnādānaṃ kāmesu micchācāro musāvādo pisuṇā vācā pharusā vācā samphappalāpo abhijjhā byāpādo micchādiṭṭhi.
dn34:2.3.62: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī musāvādā veramaṇī pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī samphappalāpā veramaṇī anabhijjhā abyāpādo sammādiṭṭhi.
dn34:2.3.66: idhāvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti chaḷaṅgasamannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panuṇṇapaccekasacco samavayasaṭṭhesano anāvilasaṅkappo passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro suvimuttacitto suvimuttapañño.
dn34:2.3.68: idhāvuso bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti byāpādo pahīno hoti thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti.
dn34:2.3.69: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti.
dn34:2.3.71: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno.
dn34:2.3.76: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno.
dn34:2.3.77: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
dn34:2.3.79: idhāvuso bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti.
dn34:2.3.80: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti.
dn34:2.3.82: idhāvuso bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti.
dn34:2.3.83: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti.
dn34:2.3.85: idhāvuso bhikkhunā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni sabbāni tāni nuṇṇāni honti panuṇṇāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni.
dn34:2.3.86: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti.
dn34:2.3.88: idhāvuso bhikkhunā kāmesanā pahīnā hoti bhavesanā pahīnā hoti brahmacariyesanā paṭinissaṭṭhā hoti.
dn34:2.3.89: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
dn34:2.3.91: idhāvuso bhikkhunā kāmasaṅkappo pahīno hoti byāpādasaṅkappo pahīno hoti vihiṃsāsaṅkappo pahīno hoti.
dn34:2.3.92: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti.
dn34:2.3.94: idhāvuso bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn34:2.3.95: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti.
dn34:2.3.97: idhāvuso bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti.
dn34:2.3.98: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti.
dn34:2.3.100: idhāvuso bhikkhu rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅgato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammoti pajānāti.
dn34:2.3.103: moho me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅgato
dn34:2.3.105: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti.
dn34:2.3.109: asubhasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā pahānasaññā virāgasaññā nirodhasaññā.
dn34:2.3.114: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.115: sammāsaṅkappassa micchāsaṅkappo nijjiṇṇo hoti ye ca micchāsaṅkappapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāsaṅkappapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.

dn34:2.3.118: sammāājīvassa micchāājīvo nijjiṇṇo hoti ye ca micchāājīvapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāājīvapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.119: sammāvāyāmassa micchāvāyāmo nijjiṇṇo hoti ye ca micchāvāyāmapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāvāyāmapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.120: sammāsatissa micchāsati nijjiṇṇā hoti ye ca micchāsatipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāsatipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.121: sammāsamādhissa micchāsamādhi nijjiṇṇo hoti ye ca micchāsamādhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāsamādhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.123: ye ca micchāñāṇapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāñāṇapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti. sammāvimuttassa micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti
dn34:2.3.124: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti tepassa nijjiṇṇā honti sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
dn34:2.3.128: asekkhā sammādiṭṭhi asekkho sammāsaṅkappo asekkhā sammāvācā asekkho sammākammanto asekkho sammāājīvo asekkho sammāvāyāmo asekkhā sammāsati asekkho sammāsamādhi asekkhaṃ sammāñāṇaṃ asekkhā sammāvimutti.
dn34:2.3.130: iti ime satadhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhāti.
dn34:2.3.132: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato sārīputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
